result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: one audit per rolling 12 months, 30 days' written notice, during business hours, by an independent auditor subject to written confidentiality obligations, with no direct or remote systems access. Section 22.2 retains the preferred 5% cost-shifting threshold. The limited additions regarding non-disruption and Customer-provided records appropriately implement the audit restrictions without materially changing unrelated commercial terms, and the clause is professionally drafted.
